title: Pointer-advance labels
statement: For natural-number parameters $a,b,f$, assign the four pointer-advance choices the following labels: choice $0$ maps to the end test before the second letter with remembered value false, choice $1$ to that end test with remembered value true, choice $2$ to the end test before a first letter, and choice $3$ to the copy site for $x:=p$.
